title: cocculus orbiculatus var. mollis
intro: Cocculus orbiculatus var. mollis, commonly known as Oriental Parasol, is a species of flowering plant in the family Menispermaceae. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to promote relaxation, reduce stress, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The plant is believed to possess health benefits due to its anti-inflammatory, sedative, and antispasmodic properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as sedation, muscle relaxation, and reduction of anxiety. The bioactive constituents of Cocculus orbiculatus var. mollis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and coumarins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
